bead.title: Document databricks as an accepted public dialect
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The public dialect contract can still be read as spark/duckdb-only, so reviewers and validators may incorrectly reject dialect="databricks" even though the implementation accepts it.
ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:49, docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:85, and docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:109 are governing acceptance artifacts whose dialect wording does not clearly preserve databricks as an accepted public dialect.
PROPOSED FIX: Update the conformance/documentation contract and its regression coverage so accepted dialect wording includes databricks alongside spark and duckdb, and fails if it regresses to spark/duckdb-only language.
NON-SCOPE: One-shot bootstrap facade implementation. Production pipeline JSON/wheel packaging contract. Inline UMF format cleanup. No real Databricks workspace execution beyond existing opt-in tiers. GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-026-compile-orchestrator-bootstrap.md:84; docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:49; docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:85; docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:109. DEPENDENCIES: parent bead tablespec-ed74497c; no additional dependencies.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestDatabricksDialectContractIsDocumented: add or update a docs/metadata regression test that fails if the accepted dialect list regresses back to spark/duckdb-only wording and omits public dialect="databricks".
2. TestPytestGate: `uv run pytest tests/docs/test_dialect_contract.py tests/unit/test_bootstrap.py`
3. TestGoGate: `go test ./...`
4. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit`
